notes: Replaces the earlier LinkedIn edit (the city of its parent's headquarters): its relation, located_in, gave no stored one-hop related question that changes in every world, and two of its checks were missed by two or three models. This edit follows the README's derived template like finance-replace-0015: BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager and is headquartered in New York, so it is New York's largest, which is rarely written. Related near and the second derived question rest on largest_asset_manager_in ⊑ headquartered_in (staging): in both worlds Fidelity is in New York. The premise-route question reaches New York through its nickname, the Big Apple (binding). Known limit, as in the template: under w1 the indeterminate answer keeps BlackRock. Negation asked as "Is it true that ... not ...?" rather than "Is it false that ...?", which two models misread in the audit. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate (AND queries, max_clause_freq 500000). Review pass 2026-11-12: counts added for the Fidelity, Big Apple and derived facts; w2 also assumes Fidelity is larger than Vanguard. Not yet audited on the four models; 'BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager' (a model may say Vanguard) and the definitional check are the likeliest misses. Related[0] is the subproperty question (Fidelity's headquarters city); related[1] is the inverse question (headquarters_of) about whether Fidelity is among Boston's headquartered companies.
